verdict.rationale: jo is a personal agent operated conversationally: the docs show natural-language requests such as "file a bug for the dropdown crash" and "what did I miss in #engineering?". They also describe asking jo to build a website and then change it conversationally, across macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp and email with shared memory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work as described, since all evidence is vendor docs.
